meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 把 GitHub 上大量 issue 按根本原因聚成少数主问题,每个主问题配设计文档;用固定评论关闭子 issue,同组修复打包成一个 PR 同时关闭多个 issue,并在 CI 加入测试矩阵防复发。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20 多个开放 issue 且很多疑似同源,或你要求对 issue 做归类/去重/制定计划,或想判断新 bug 是否属于已有工作时触发。

say.text: 把所有开放的 issue 按根本原因归类成几个 plan-master。
say.note: 会先通读全部 issue 和评论,再创建主问题与设计文档。

say.text: 判断这个新 bug 是否属于现有计划,是就并入相应计划并关闭。
say.note: 触发 triage 模式,追加 Round N 评论。

say.text: 把 plan-02 的修复打包成一个 PR,自动关闭所有子 issue。
say.note: 触发 bundle 模式,生成带 Closes 的 PR。

howto.what_en: Clusters GitHub issues by root cause into plan-masters, mirrors each in a design doc, closes children with a standard redirect, and bundles fixes into one PR that closes them atomically, adding a regression matrix to CI.
howto.when_en: When the repo has 20+ open issues, many possibly sharing root causes, or when asked to triage/consolidate/dedupe issues, build a plan from open issues, or route a new bug into existing work.

say_en.text: Cluster all open issues by root cause into a few plan-masters.
say_en.note: It reads every issue and comment, then creates masters and docs.

say_en.text: Check if this new bug belongs to an existing plan; if so, fold it in and close it.
say_en.note: Runs triage, appending a Round N comment.

say_en.text: Bundle plan-02's fix into one PR that auto-closes all child issues.
say_en.note: Runs bundle mode, generating a PR with Closes tags.
